sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
This roadmap is designed to take you from a beginner to an expert in Python Data Structures and Algorithms. Each topic includes 20 carefully curated problems (5 Easy, 10 Medium, 5 Hard) to ensure mastery.

**Estimated Timeline**: 6-8 months (with consistent 3-4 hours daily practice)

sections.title: Topic 1: Time and Space Complexity Analysis
sections.body:
### 📚 Key Concepts

- Big O, Big Theta, Big Omega notations
- Best, Average, Worst case analysis
- Space complexity
- Analyzing recursive algorithms

### 🎯 Practice Problems

#### Easy (5)

1. Calculate time complexity of a given code snippet with nested loops
2. Find the time complexity of printing all elements in an array
3. Identify space complexity of recursive factorial function
4. Compare time complexities: O(n) vs O(n²) vs O(log n)
5. Calculate complexity of binary search

#### Medium (10)

1. Analyze time complexity of merge sort
2. Calculate space complexity of a recursive Fibonacci function
3. Optimize a O(n²) solution to O(n)
4. Find time complexity of nested loops with different ranges
5. Analyze complexity when input size doubles
6. Calculate amortized time complexity of dynamic array operations
7. Find complexity of a recursive function with multiple recursive calls
8. Compare iterative vs recursive space complexity
9. Analyze best, average, and worst case for quicksort
10. Calculate time complexity of a function with early termination

#### Hard (5)

1. Master theorem application for divide-and-conquer algorithms
2. Analyze complexity of multi-dimensional dynamic programming
3. Calculate amortized complexity of union-find with path compression
4. Time complexity analysis of Fibonacci with memoization vs tabulation
5. Analyze space-time tradeoff in different algorithms

sections.title: Daily Practice Routine
sections.body:
1. **Morning (1 hour)**: Review concepts, watch tutorials
2. **Afternoon (2 hours)**: Solve 2-3 problems
3. **Evening (1 hour)**: Review solutions, analyze patterns

sections.title: Problem-Solving Strategy
sections.body:
1. **Understand**: Read problem 2-3 times, clarify doubts
2. **Plan**: Think of approach, identify patterns
3. **Implement**: Write clean code with edge cases
4. **Test**: Test with examples and edge cases
5. **Optimize**: Analyze time/space complexity, optimize if needed

sections.title: Pro Tips
sections.body:
1. **Consistency > Intensity**: 2 hours daily > 14 hours once a week
2. **Quality > Quantity**: Understand deeply rather than solving quickly
3. **Revise Regularly**: Revisit problems after 1 week, 1 month
4. **Time Yourself**: Practice with timer to simulate interviews
5. **Write Code on Paper**: Improves thinking without IDE
6. **Explain Out Loud**: Teaches you to communicate during interviews
7. **Focus on Patterns**: Same patterns repeat across problems
8. **Don't Memorize**: Understand logic and approach
9. **Track Mistakes**: Maintain error log
10. **Mock Interviews**: Practice with peers regularly
